purpose: Make the first real paid delivery promotable to CUSTOMER_DELIVERY and, only when separately supported by authoritative settlement/reconciliation evidence, REVENUE_VERIFIED without reconstructing evidence after the fact.
truth_boundary: This template is not a customer, order, payment, settlement, delivery, acceptance or revenue record. Empty/example fields must never be published as proof.
promotion_checks: Do not promote CUSTOMER_DELIVERY without a real commercial basis and acceptance or delivery evidence.
Do not expose private customer identity or payment evidence without a valid disclosure basis.
Do not promote REVENUE_VERIFIED from checkout creation, QR rendering, invoice issuance, pending transfer or provider dashboard state alone.
Do not promote REVENUE_VERIFIED if test_payment, related_party_payment or founder_funded is true.
REVENUE_VERIFIED requires externally settled evidence reconciled to the canonical order under Commerce authority.
A revenue record must bind to the corresponding real delivered offer when delivery is part of the commercial obligation.
Refund/reversal status must remain append-only and may require later correction/revocation of public commercial claims.
